diff --git a/outlines/types/__init__.py b/outlines/types/__init__.py
index 85af9adc..81814d82 100644
--- a/outlines/types/__init__.py
+++ b/outlines/types/__init__.py
@@ -59,6 +59,15 @@ email = Regex(
     r"""(?:[a-z0-9!#$%&'*+/=?^_`{|}~-]+(?:\.[a-z0-9!#$%&'*+/=?^_`{|}~-]+)*|"(?:[\x01-\x08\x0b\x0c\x0e-\x1f\x21\x23-\x5b\x5d-\x7f]|\\[\x01-\x09\x0b\x0c\x0e-\x7f])*")@(?:(?:[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?\.)+[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?|\[(?:(?:(2(5[0-5]|[0-4][0-9])|1[0-9][0-9]|[1-9]?[0-9]))\.){3}(?:(2(5[0-5]|[0-4][0-9])|1[0-9][0-9]|[1-9]?[0-9])|[a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9]:(?:[\x01-\x08\x0b\x0c\x0e-\x1f\x21-\x5a\x53-\x7f]|\\[\x01-\x09\x0b\x0c\x0e-\x7f])+)\])"""
 )
 
+# Matches 16-digit credit card numbers written as four groups of four digits.
+# The groups are either run together, or all separated by a single space, or
+# all separated by a single hyphen: mixing separators ("1234 5678-9012-3456")
+# is refused. The pattern avoids a backreference to the first separator, as
+# the regex engines that build the guided-generation automaton do not support
+# them. The number is not checked against the Luhn checksum or the card
+# networks' prefixes, only against its format.
+credit_card = Regex(r"[0-9]{16}|[0-9]{4}( [0-9]{4}){3}|[0-9]{4}(-[0-9]{4}){3}")
+
 # Matches any ISBN number. Note that this is not completely correct as not all
 # 10 or 13 digits numbers are valid ISBNs. See https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISBN
 # Taken from O'Reilly's Regular Expression Cookbook:
@@ -68,3 +77,20 @@ email = Regex(
 isbn = Regex(
     r"(?:ISBN(?:-1[03])?:? )?(?=[0-9X]{10}$|(?=(?:[0-9]+[- ]){3})[- 0-9X]{13}$|97[89][0-9]{10}$|(?=(?:[0-9]+[- ]){4})[- 0-9]{17}$)(?:97[89][- ]?)?[0-9]{1,5}[- ]?[0-9]+[- ]?[0-9]+[- ]?[0-9X]"
 )
+
+# Matches HTTP and HTTPS web URLs: the scheme, optional user info, a host (a
+# domain name with at least one dot, localhost, an IPv4 address or a bracketed
+# IPv6 address), an optional port, path, query and fragment. Spaces and the
+# characters that RFC 3986 forbids are never accepted. The pattern uses no
+# lookaround, so the regex engine that guides generation can compile it too.
+url = Regex(
+    r"https?://"
+    r"(?:[a-zA-Z0-9._~%!$&'()*+,;=:-]+@)?"
+    r"(?:(?:[a-zA-Z0-9](?:[a-zA-Z0-9-]*[a-zA-Z0-9])?\.)+[a-zA-Z0-9](?:[a-zA-Z0-9-]*[a-zA-Z0-9])?"
+    r"|localhost"
+    r"|\[[0-9a-fA-F:.]+\])"
+    r"(?::[0-9]{1,5})?"
+    r"(?:/[a-zA-Z0-9._~%!$&'()*+,;=:@/-]*)?"
+    r"(?:\?[a-zA-Z0-9._~%!$&'()*+,;=:@/?\[\]-]*)?"
+    r"(?:#[a-zA-Z0-9._~%!$&'()*+,;=:@/?\[\]-]*)?"
+)
